name: The Turned-Away
pitch: Every gate in their life has refused them, and so does the last one: each failed breakthrough is one more time they fail to die.
channel: art hit, from a health floor

new.name: The Copyist's Error
new.effect: While the Spent Kiln Sutra is main, every great breakthrough attempt fails with no roll, needs no pill and ignores bare_attempt_cap; each failure leaves a Gate Scar.

new.name: Turned Away
new.effect: At the defeat check, a side at 0 health with an unopened Gate Scar and 15 % of maximum linh lực pays it, opens one scar and stands at 5 % health. One per instant.

new.name: Cracked Perfection
new.effect: +0.05 to stage_mult on damage per Gate Scar, past great perfection.
new.second_home: any cultivator stuck at a gate

new.name: Refused Force
new.effect: +15 points to hits per health floor held this fight.
new.second_home: any build with a floor, such as Unyielding Breath

new.name: Raw Scar
new.effect: +30 points to hits for 4 seasons after a failed great breakthrough, in any situation, even a blind fight.
new.second_home: anyone who fails on purpose before a duel

new.name: Reopened
new.effect: +0.6 points to hits per 1 % of health missing.

new.name: Spent Kiln Sutra
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Fire and Earth. A firing manual with one reversed line, which is why nobody under it has ever passed a gate. Carries The Copyist's Error and Turned Away.

new.name: The Gate Opens Inward
new.effect: Qi hit, c_art 4.1, health 0.08, 6 s. Timed to land in the last instant four scars buy.

new.name: Hearth Ash Talisman
new.effect: Refunds 15 % of maximum linh lực while under 45 %.

new.name: Waster Heap
new.effect: Sealed, Earth, size 8. Wounds and vitality. Sealed by a technique or three failed great breakthroughs. Notable: Reopened.

new.name: Way of the Threshold
new.effect: Fire and Earth at purity 25. Branches Knock, Crack, Refusal. Keystone Cracked Perfection.

new.name: Gate Scar
new.effect: A saved count of failed great breakthroughs for every character, reset by a success. Does nothing without a piece that reads it.

questions: The difficulty targets mean most lives stall at a gate. Should a stalled life have a real second path?
Turned Away runs through a campaign plug-in that hooks the defeat check. Should the calculator gain a health-floor rule?
